notes.title: NEW UPDATE AFTER FOREVER
notes.notes:
Hey noble SJW's, we didn't forget about you!

We've finally updated the game.

Here are the goodies:

-NEW FEATURE: Change your character's [b]SKIN COLOR[/b] to ANY color from the palette!
-NEW FEATURE: Design your own [b]CUSTOM BANNER[/b]!

-NEW DLC - FLAG PACK - Featuring over 40 new banners for you to choose from!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/674970/FEMINAZI_Flag_Pack

-DLC menu: you can see which dlc packs you have installed from the ingame menu.

-Gender editor is now Gender Creator!


-FPS and RAM optimization! Woo!


Mother Russia DLC:
-Moved the Airport(entry point for dlc) near the starting location in the original map, to allow for easier access
-revamped the whole map, bosses are still in their original locations, but the environment looks different now
-combat is more fluid and less clunky now



BUG FIXES:
-Fixed a bug where players would get stuck in the police minigame


Stay triggered! 

ːtriggeredː

notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
Some new game features:


-added the ability to mace white males, this uses up your graffiti spray (same button as graffiti)
-added the ability to smash cars with a hammer (same button as graffiti, uses up hammers)
-your hair will now be set on fire if you get triggered by 3 or more white males at once. Beware, it might burn away :)
-added screams to white males when you get triggered by them


-fixed some minor bugs

Controller support coming soon! ːtriggeredː

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
-Added a gui element to better visualize controls
-Added a toggleable grid to gender editor
-Added a better description in the abortion minigame
-Improved the dance minigame

-Fixed a minor bug in gender editor where you had to remove a pixel before placing another one
-Fixed Steam Stats not updating properly which caused problems with some achievements
-Other minor bug fixes

-You can now scroll the credits faster with arrow keys

[b]More updates coming soon![/b] ːtriggeredː
